blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding how neurons respond to visual stimulus is an important question in both deep learning and neuroscience. It has significant implications for enhancing the interpretability of black-box artificial neural networks and for understanding the visual representation in the human brain. We propose a structured visual representations landscape and design an activation-based prior that allows us to effectively regularize the landscape with activations from brain regions or neural network units. Our model Vis-Lens integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model into an image generation framework. It enables the generation of natural, realistic preferred images by directly modifying the activation-regularized latent codes without per-image iterative optimization. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework on both artificial neural networks and human visual cortex using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data. Our framework improves activation modulation and image realism compared with a recent state-of-the-art method for generating preferred visual representations of these neural targets.
blocks.zh: 理解神经元如何响应视觉刺激,是深入学习和神经科学中的一个重要问题. 它对于增强黑盒人工神经网络的可解释性,以及对于理解人脑中的视觉表现具有重大影响. 我们提出一个结构化的视觉表现图,并设计一个基于激活的先行,使我们能够通过脑区域或神经网络单元的活化来有效地规范地貌. 我们的Vis-Lens模型将可变自编码器和扩散模型整合到图像生成框架. 它通过直接修改激活-正态化潜伏代码而无需进行成像迭代优化,从而能够生成自然的,现实的首选图像. 我们利用功能磁共振成像(fMRI)数据,在人工神经网络和人类视觉皮层上展示我们的框架的有效性. 我们的框架改进了激活调制和图像现实主义,比起最近一种最先进的方法来产生这些神经目标的优先视觉表现.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
The exploration of visual representations in both biological and artificial neural networks has advanced our understanding of how complex visual stimuli are processed and represented in neural networks ( Marr, 2010 ; Hubel and Wiesel, 1962 ; Bashivan et al., 2019 ) .
Previous studies have demonstrated the capacity of neurons in the medial temporal lobe (MTL) of the human brain to form invariant representations of complex stimuli ( Quiroga et al., 2005 ) , such as faces, landmarks, and objects, regardless of visual variations. These findings illustrate how single neurons can encode high-level, abstract percepts with remarkable specificity, leading to the hypothesis of sparse and invariant coding mechanisms in the brain ( Olshausen and Field, 2004 ) .
blocks.zh:
对生物和人工神经网络中视觉表现的探索,推进了我们对复杂的视觉刺激如何处理和表现在神经网络的理解(Marr,2010;Hubel和Wiesel,1962;Bashivan等,2019).
以往的研究表明,人类大脑的中间时间叶(MTL)神经元能够形成复杂刺激(Quiroga等,2005年)的变异表现,如面相,地标,和物体等,无论视觉变化如何. 这些发现说明了单个神经元如何能以显著的特异性来编码高层次,抽象的感知,导致大脑中零星和无常的编码机制的假说(Olshausen and Field, 2004.).

blocks.en: Figure 1. Original CLIP Space (Top): Original CLIP embedding space without any activation constraint: image embeddings that elicit high and low neural responses are dispersed and not clustered throughout the space without shared visual structure. Structured Landscape (Bottom): By encoding CLIP embeddings into the regularized latent space constrained with neuronal activations (after z-score normalization) as the prior , our method Vis-Lens could provide a more structured and representative landscape to better identify the representations and preferences of brain regions than sorting top-k images in a dataset. The results are based on brain activations from the NSD dataset ( Allen et al., 2021 ) . In the landscape plots, the color bar and z axis indicate the activation of the target brain region given different images as inputs, while the x and y axes represent two latent dimensions, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图 1. 原始CLIP空间(Top): CLIP嵌入空间没有任何活性约束:引出高低神经响应的图像嵌入被分散,没有共享的视觉结构,整个空间不集群. 结构地貌 (Bottom): 通过将CLIP嵌入受神经元活化(z分数常态后)约束的正态潜在空间编码为前作,我们的方法Vis-Lens可以提供一个更有条理和代表性的地貌,以更好地识别大脑区域的表达和偏好,而不是在数据集中分拣上克图像. 结果基于NSD数据集的脑活化(Allen等,2021年). 在地貌地块中,彩色条和z轴表示目标大脑区域的活化作为输入的不同图像,而x和y轴分别代表了两个潜在的维度.

blocks.en: While methods exploring visual representation in some brain regions work fine by learning directly from embeddings of popular image encoders like CLIP ( Garcia Cerdas et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) , understanding the feature representations for many brain regions that are not well-studied remains challenging. For example, some higher-order brain regions can demonstrate mixed selectivity ( Rigotti et al., 2013 ) , where they can respond to images with small overlap in shared features. As presented in Figure 1 , the top images that maximally activate the brain region are distributed across the embedding space of the CLIP encoder ( Radford et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 虽然在一些大脑区域探索视觉表现的方法通过直接从CLIP等受欢迎的图像编码器的嵌入中学习而有效(Garcia Cerdas等,2025;Luo等,2023),但了解许多未被充分研究的大脑区域的特征表现仍然具有挑战性. 例如,一些高阶大脑区域可以表现出混合选择性(Rigotti等,2013年),它们可以对共享特征中小相重叠的图像作出反应. 如图1所示,最大限度激活大脑区域的顶部图像分布在CLIP编码器的嵌入空间上(Radford等,2021年).

blocks.en: Additionally, brain activity measured is often noisy, low-resolution, and partially observed, which introduces difficulties for analysis and modeling. Unlike previous works that aim to reconstruct entire images from brain activities ( Naselaris et al., 2011 ; Nishimoto et al., 2011 ; Shen et al., 2019 ; Horikawa and Kamitani, 2017 ) , our work focuses on understanding the feature representation of brain regions by generating new preferred images that maximize or minimize the activity of those regions. These synthetic visual stimuli can be deployed in follow-up neuroscience experiments to test new hypotheses, refine ROI functional maps, and accelerate discovery by guiding stimulus design.
blocks.zh: 此外,测得的大脑活性常有噪音,分辨度低并部分被观察到,这给分析和建模带来了困难. 与以往旨在从大脑活动中重建整个图像的作品不同(Naselaris等,2011年;Nishimoto等,2011年;Shen等,2019年;Horikawa和Kamitani,2017年),我们的工作重点是通过生成新的首选图像来了解大脑区域的特点表现,从而最大限度地或最大限度地减少这些区域的活动。 这些合成视觉刺激可以被部署在后续神经科学实验中来测试新的假说,完善ROI功能图,并通过指导刺激设计来加速发现.

blocks.en: To achieve this goal, we propose Vis-Lens, an effective approach to interpret the feature represented by brain regions. Given the noisy nature of brain recordings, instead of using brain activities directly as input to the decoding model, our method refines the landscape of visual representation by employing brain activation to regularize the prior, serving as a soft constraint. We further integrate the structured landscape with a variational auto-encoder (VAE) and diffusion generative models to generate realistic preferred images that can effectively modulate target brain activations.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一目标,我们提出Vis-Lens,一种解释由大脑区域代表的特征的有效方法. 鉴于大脑录音的吵闹性质,我们的方法不是直接利用大脑活动作为解码模型的输入,而是通过利用大脑活化来规范前作,发挥软约束作用来完善视觉表现的地貌. 我们进一步将结构化的地貌与可变自动编码器(VAE)相融合,并传播基因模型,以产生现实的首选图像,可以有效调制目标脑活化.

blocks.en: Our method can facilitate the exploration of visual representations of brain regions while maintaining interpretability. It is validated with fMRI data from the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) ( Allen et al., 2021 ) , analyzing responses in the human visual cortex to complex natural stimuli. Meanwhile, due to the scarcity of image response data from human brains, our proposed framework is also extended to artificial neural networks (ANNs), allowing controlled testing of visual feature representations and interpretability in artificial systems. By integrating insights from both biological and artificial neural networks, we aim to bridge the understanding of visual representation strategies across natural and engineered systems. Our contributions can be outlined as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的方法可以促进大脑区域视觉表现的探索,同时保持可解释性. 它通过从"自然景地数据集"(NSD)(Allen等,2021年)得到的fMRI数据进行验证,分析人类视觉皮层对复杂自然刺激的反应. 同时,由于人类大脑的图像响应数据稀缺,我们提出的框架也被扩展至人工神经网络(ANNs),允许在人工系统中对视觉特征表现和可解释性进行有控制的测试. 通过将生物神经网络和人工神经网络的洞察力结合起来,我们的目标是在自然和工程系统中沟通对视觉表现战略的理解。 我们的贡献可概述如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce an activation-regularized prior for VAE ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) that organizes its latent space into two distinct clusters, corresponding to codes that increase or decrease a target brain region’s activation. This design enables easy plug-and-play integration with conventional generative models. • Our method synthesizes visual representations from specified brain regions, showing better performance to regularize brain activations than a recent state-of-the-art baseline, especially for decreasing activations. It could also generate preferred visual inputs with better perceptual realism. Moreover, it provides a generalized framework which shows robustness on cross-subject biological data, and can also be transferred to visualizing features in artificial neural networks. • By generating controllable, high-quality visual stimuli that can modulate specific regions, our framework demonstrates new potential in vision-based brain computer interface applications and can be used to generate new hypotheses for future neuroscience studies.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们引入了VAE(Kingma和Welling,2013年)之前的激活规范,将它的潜在空间组织成两个截然不同的集群,与增加或减少目标大脑区域激活的代码相对应。 这种设计可以方便地与传统的基因模型进行插接和游戏集成. 二. 支助 我们的方法合成了来自特定大脑区域的视觉表现,表现出比最近最先进的基线更好的性能来规范大脑活化,特别是用于减少活化. 它还可以产生更好的视觉现实主义的首选视觉投入。 此外,它提供了一个总体框架,显示跨主题生物数据的强性,还可以被转移到人工神经网络的可视化特征上。 通过产生可以调节特定区域的可控,高品质的视觉刺激,我们的框架显示了基于视觉的脑计算机接口应用的新潜力,并可用于为未来的神经科学研究产生新的假设.

blocks.en: 2. Related Works
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工程

blocks.en:
Image generative models. Advances in generative models have significantly transformed image synthesis. Foundational approaches such as GANs ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ) led to extensions like Wasserstein GANs ( Arjovsky et al., 2017 ) and Conditional GANs ( Mirza and Osindero, 2014 ) , with fidelity improvements using spectral normalization ( Miyato et al., 2018 ) , while VAEs ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) introduced probabilistic encoding, later combined with latent space regularization ( Ho et al., 2022 ; Van den Oord et al., 2016 ) . Further, Cascaded generation ( Ho et al., 2022 ) and autoregressive modeling ( Chen et al., 2018 ) enhanced synthesis quality. More superior generation models like Diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) advanced controllable, high-fidelity synthesis, integrating structured perturbations via SDEdit ( Meng et al., 2022 ) and text-to-image alignment through CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . IP-Adapter ( Ye et al., 2023 ) refined latent spaces for semantic consistency, while GLIDE ( Nichol et al., 2022 ) and Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) further demonstrated photorealistic, text-guided image generation.
Our work is developed based on these conventional generative model frameworks, it adopts VAEs to build up our proposed structured landscape and a Stable Diffusion model generation pipeline to synthesize preferred images conditioned on CLIP embeddings derived from the structured landscape.
blocks.zh:
影像遗传模型. 基因模型的进步极大地改变了图像合成. GANs(Goodfellow等,2014年)等基础方法导致了Wasserstein GANs(Arjovsky等,2017年)和有条件的GANs(Mirza和Osindero,2014年)等扩展,利用光谱正常化(Miyato等,2018年)提高了忠诚度,而VAEs(Kingma和 Welling,2013年)则引入了概率编码,后来与潜在的空间规范化相结合(Ho等,2022年;Van den Oord等,2016年). 此外,Cascaded生成(Ho等,2022年)和自旋模型(Chen等,2018年)提高了合成质量. 更优越的生成模型如分化模型(Ho等,2020;Rombach等,2022)可高级可控,高纯度合成,通过SDEdit(Meng等,2022)将结构化扰动整合,通过CLIP实现文本对映(Radford等,2021). IP-Adapter(Ye等人,2023年)精炼了语义一致性的潜在空间,而GLIDE(Nichol等人,2022年)和Stable Divusion(Rombach等人,2022年)进一步证明了光现实主义,文字引导图像生成.
我们的工作是在这些传统的基因模型框架的基础上发展起来的,它采用VAEs来构建我们拟议的结构化地貌,以及一个稳定的分化模型生成管道来合成以结构化地貌所生的CLIP嵌入为条件的首选图像.

blocks.en: Feature visualization. Visualization techniques provide deep insights into neural network interpretability and functionality, spanning both biological and artificial systems. Early work by Erhan et al. ( Erhan et al., 2009 ) focused on minimal regularization approaches, while adversarial examples exposed vulnerabilities in neural networks ( Szegedy et al., 2013 ) . Mahendran and Vedaldi ( Mahendran and Vedaldi, 2015 ) and Nguyen et al. ( Nguyen et al., 2015 ) further expanded on interpretability with total variation regularization, counterexamples, and image blurring. Meanwhile, techniques such as DeepDream by Mordvintsev et al. ( Mordvintsev et al., 2015 ; Mordvintsev et al., 2016 ) , employing jitter, multi-scale visualization, and gradient normalization ( Øygard, 2015 ; Tyka, 2016 ) , enhanced clarity in feature visualization. For prior related work, Nguyen et al. ( Nguyen et al., 2016 ) demonstrated generative adversarial synthesis of preferred inputs, emphasizing controlled image generation through learned priors. Our work extends this line by generating images with preferred features based on pre-defined priors in landscape shaped by activations.
blocks.zh: 特色可视化. 可视化技术提供了对神经网络可解释性和功能的深刻见解,跨越了生物和人工系统. 早期由埃尔汉等作. (Erhan等人,2009年)侧重于最低限度的正规化方法,而对抗性的例子暴露出神经网络中的脆弱性(Szegedy等人,2013年)。 马亨德兰和维达尔迪(Mahendran and Vedaldi, 2015)和阮等. (Nguyen等,2015年)进一步扩展了可解释性,全变态化,反例,图像模糊. 同时,由莫德文采夫等所著"DeepDream"等技术. (Mordvintsev等, 2015; Mordvintsev等, 2016.),使用快活,多尺度可视化,并实现梯度常态化(Øygard, 2015; Tyka, 2016.),使特征可视化更加清晰. 关于先前的相关工作,Nguyen等。 (Nguyen等,2016年)展示了首选投入的基因对抗性合成,强调通过所学前科产生受控图像. 我们的工作扩展了这条线,通过在由激活所塑造的地貌上,根据预先定义的前题生成具有首选特征的图像.

blocks.en: Brain decoding and most exciting images. Generative models leveraging brain activity as direct input have substantially advanced neural-to-visual synthesis. Direct neural-to-image synthesis methods convert fMRI activity into high-fidelity pictures with diffusion or GAN backbones, like BrainDiffusion and NeuroDM ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) , Brain2GAN ( Dado et al., 2024 ) , latent-diffusion variants ( Ferrante et al., 2024 ; Ozcelik and VanRullen, 2023 ) , and energy-guided approaches ( Pierzchlewicz et al., 2023 ) , while activation-optimized methods like Inception Loops ( Walker et al., 2019 ) and NeuroGen ( Gu et al., 2022 ) reveal neuronal tuning by iterating stimuli based on neural responses. Recent brain decoding studies have continued to improve visual reconstruction quality through stronger priors, better alignment spaces, and cross-subject or data-efficient formulations, including generative decoding with latent diffusion ( Takagi and Nishimoto, 2023 ; Ozcelik and VanRullen, 2023 ) , diffusion-prior-based reconstruction ( Scotti et al., 2023 ; Scotti et al., 2024 ) , probabilistic visual-to-fMRI synthesis ( Mai et al., 2025 ) , and cross-subject decoding frameworks ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . Recent multi-modal approaches ( Huang et al., 2021 ; Ding et al., 2023 ; van Gerven, 2021 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ; Benara et al., 2024 ; Huo et al., 2026 ) integrate generative models for improved synthesis precision, while Controllable Mind Visual Diffusion ( Zeng et al., 2023 ) , Seeing Beyond the Brain ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , and Reconstructing the Mind’s Eye ( Scotti et al., 2023 ) leverage structured diffusion priors for enhanced visual reconstructions. Beyond reconstruction, recent methods have also explored richer alignment spaces between brain signals and foundation-model representations, such as CLIP-based decoding ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and self-supervised visual representations including DINO-style encoders ( Benchetrit et al., 2024 ) . Though dominated by fMRI data, ( Song et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; de la Torre-Ortiz and Ruotsalo, 2024 ; Ma and Ruotsalo, 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Abramov, 2025 ) explored on EEG data, obtained promising results.
blocks.zh: 大脑解码和最刺激的图像. 利用大脑活性作为直接输入的基因模型具有相当高的神经到视觉合成能力. 直接神经成像合成方法将fMRI活性转化为具有扩散或GAN骨干的高真能图片,如脑分泌和神经分解(Luo等,2023;Qian等,2024),Brain2GAN. (Dado等人,2024年),潜在扩散变体 (Ferrante等人,2024年;Ozcelik和VanRullen,2023年),和能导方法(Pierzchlewicz等人,2023年),同时激活-优化方法如Inception Loops(Walker等人,2019年)和NeuroGen(Gu等人,2022年)根据神经反应揭示出通过活化刺激来进行神经调节. 近期的大脑解码研究通过更强的前科,更好的对接空间,以及跨主体或数据高效的配体,包括基因解码与潜在扩散(高木和西本,2023;Ozcelik和Vanrullen,2023),扩散前重建(Scotti等,2023;Scotti等,2024),概率可视到f),不断提高视觉重建质量. 核磁共振综合(Mai等,2025年),和跨主体解码框架(Wang等,2024年). 最近的多式办法(黄等,2021;丁等,2023;范格尔文,2021;邱等. 2025; Benara等, 2024; Hoo等, 2026) 整合基因模型来提高合成精度,而可控心智视觉分泌(Zeng等, 2023) , Seeing Beyond the Brain(Chen等,2023年),再造Mind's Eye(Scotti等,2023年)利用结构化的传播前科增强视觉重建. 除了重建之外,最近的方法还探索了脑信号和地基模型表示的更丰富的对接空间,如基于CLIP的解码(Liu等,2023年)和包括DINO风格编码器(Benchetrit等,2024年)在内的自我监督的视觉表现. 虽然以fMRI数据为主,但(Song等人,2024年;Li等人,2024年;de la Torre-Ortiz和Ruotsalo,2024年;Ma和Ruotsalo,2024年;Li等人,2025年;Abramov,2025年)在EEG数据上进行了探讨,取得了可喜的成果。

blocks.en: To further modulate activations, computational models ( Papale et al., 2024 ; Murty et al., 2021 ) and frameworks targeting single neuron contributions ( Bau and others, 2017 ; Olah and others, 2017 ) provide interpretable mappings of cortical activations to specific visual features. Latent space optimization strategies ( Robinson et al., 2023 ; Xia et al., 2024 ) extend foundational decoding frameworks ( Naselaris et al., 2011 ; Nishimoto et al., 2011 ; Shen et al., 2019 ; Horikawa and Kamitani, 2017 ) to achieve targeted neural activation modulation. BrainDiVE and BrainSCUBA ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2024 ) uses a CLIP-based encoder and diffusion models to improve stimulus quality and semantic specificity. BrainACTIV ( Garcia Cerdas et al., 2025 ) , as the recent state-of-the-art and the first work on using diffusion models to generate images to regulate brain activations, extends these paradigms by conditioning synthesis with linearly fitted CLIP embeddings and brain activation patterns. Related efforts in controllable activation synthesis have also shown that generative models can be used not only to maximize neural responses but also to suppress or differentially modulate them, both in biological systems and in artificial networks ( Bashivan et al., 2019 ; Shinkle and Lescroart, 2025 ; Nguyen et al., 2017 ) . Although modeling activations via CLIP embeddings does work in previous work, our method tries to take the noisy and mix-selective nature of brain activity data into consideration, building a novel structured landscape in VAE through CLIP embeddings, permitting more controllable and effective activation manipulation, and avoiding falling into local minimum in the optimization process.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步调制活化,Papale等的计算模型(Papale等,2024;Murty等,2021)和针对单神经元贡献的框架(Bau等,2017;Olah等,2017)提供了可解释的皮质活化图以特定视觉特征. 后期空间优化战略(Robinson等,2023;Xia等,2024)扩展了基础解码框架(Naselaris等,2011;Nishimoto等,2011;Shen等,2019;Horikawa和Kamitani,2017),以实现定向神经活化调制. 大脑和大脑系统 (Luo等人,2023;Luo等人,2024)使用基于CLIP的编码和传播模型来提高刺激质量和语义特异性. 3.2. Constructing a Structured VAE Landscape with Activation-Constrained Priors

blocks.en:
To generate explainable and controllable preferred visual representations for a specific brain region or neural unit, we incorporate the target activation r r into the VAE prior and use it to organize the latent space.
The key intuition is that neural signals are noisy and could have an asymmetric distribution. To better represent those properties, we design a prior for the neural responses that they have a bimodal distribution, with significant responses (most positive or negative) are expected to be centralized in each distribution. The greater the absolute value of activation is, the closer it will be to each distribution center, and responses close to zero are relatively loosely constrained.
This design yields a structured latent landscape that supports direct latent manipulation at test time.

关键的直觉是神经信号很吵,可能具有不对称的分布. 为了更好地代表这些属性,我们为神经反应设计了一个前置答案,即它们具有双模式分布,重要反应(大多数是正或负)预计将集中在每个分布中. 活化的绝对值越多,它就越接近每个分布中心,接近于零的响应受到相对松散的限制.
这种设计产生了一种结构化的潜伏地貌,支持试验时的直接潜伏操纵.

The VAE is the only trainable component in the pipeline, while the pretrained CLIP encoder ( ℰ \mathcal{E} ) and the image-to-image diffusion model remain frozen.

blocks.zh: 4.1. 数据集

blocks.en: Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD). The Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), introduced by Allen et al. ( Allen et al., 2021 ) , provides high-resolution fMRI recordings from eight subjects viewing approximately 10,000 MS COCO images ( Lin et al., 2015 ) , each repeated three times to enhance data consistency. Following standard fMRI encoding practices ( Naselaris et al., 2011 ; van Gerven, 2017 ) , beta values are z-scored within sessions and averaged across repetitions. ROI masks are utilized to extract activation patterns from specific brain regions, serving as essential constraints in our framework to align the VAE latent space with observed brain responses in 4.3.1 .

blocks.en: ImageNet-mini. ImageNet-mini is a subset of the full ImageNet dataset ( Deng et al., 2009 ) , offering a diverse collection of images across various categories. This dataset serves as a benchmark for evaluating the performance of modulating artificial units from SIMCLR ( Chen et al., 2020 ) in 4.3.2 and validating optimization performance under constrained image dimensions in 4.3.3 .

blocks.en: 4.2. Models

Implementation of our framework. Our VAE uses a linear encoder to map CLIP embeddings into an activation-constrained latent space and a linear decoder to reconstruct CLIP embeddings for controlled image synthesis. We use a pretrained CLIP-ViT-H-14 encoder ( Radford et al., 2021 ) to extract 1024-dimensional embeddings, and Stable Diffusion v1.5 with IP-Adapter ( Ye et al., 2023 ) as the image generator.
blocks.zh: 执行我们的框架。 我们的VAE使用线性编码器来将CLIP嵌入到活化-受约束的潜在空间中,并使用线性解码器来重建CLIP嵌入来进行受控图像合成. 我们使用预选的CLIP-ViT-H-14编码器(Radford等,2021年)来提取出1024维嵌入物,而用IP-Adapter(Ye等,2023年)来进行稳定分化v1.5作为图像生成器.

blocks.en:
Baseline method. For every ROI, we re-implement BrainACTIV ( Garcia Cerdas et al., 2025 ) , a ridge-regularized linear model on ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized CLIP embeddings, [ x ∥ x ∥ ⋅ 𝐰 + b ] ⟹ r [\;\tfrac{x}{\lVert x\rVert}\cdot\mathbf{w}\;+\;b\;]\;\Longrightarrow\;r , yielding a single modulation vector 𝐰 ∈ ℝ 1024 \mathbf{w}\!\in\!\mathbb{R}^{1024} . This vector is interpreted as the direction of maximal and minimal activation in CLIP space: 𝐳 max = 𝐰 / ∥ 𝐰 ∥ \mathbf{z}_{\max}=\mathbf{w}/\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert and 𝐳 min = − 𝐰 / ∥ 𝐰 ∥ \mathbf{z}_{\min}=-\mathbf{w}/\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert . At inference time, a test CLIP embedding is shifted only along 𝐳 max \mathbf{z}_{\max} or 𝐳 min \mathbf{z}_{\min} before being injected, via an unchanged adapter, into a frozen image-to-image diffusion model.

blocks.en: Figure 3 and Table 1 show results on the NSD dataset. Our method produces activation changes in the intended direction across all reported ROIs, whereas the BrainACTIV ( Garcia Cerdas et al., 2025 ) fails to do so in several cases, especially for activation decrease. In particular, our method yields a larger decrease in activation in all reported regions, supporting the use of an independent negative prior rather than simply reversing the maximal direction used in the BrainACTIV. For activation increase, the advantage of our method is most evident in less-studied or mixed-selective regions such as TE2p, IP0, and IP1, while performance is more comparable in strongly category-selective regions such as OFA, FFA, EBA, and OPA. Our method also consistently produces more realistic visual representations, as indicated by lower FID scores ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) . Those results demonstrate that, compared with linear interpolation method in BrainACTIV, which the negative direction is simply the reverse of the positive one, the key advantage of our method is constructing a structured space to make in-distribution sampling easier, mitigating out-of-distribution problem in linear interpolation method, which could produce consistently correct activation change, and generating more realistic images because sample from such latent space will avoid over-shift from original image representations. This is particularly useful when the target representation is noisy or mixed-selective.
blocks.zh: 图3和表1显示了ND数据集的结果。 我们的方法使所有报告交战国在预定方向上发生活化变化,而BrainACTIV(Garcia Cerdas等,2025年)在若干情况下未能做到这一点,特别是为了活化减少。 特别是,我们的方法使所有报告区域的激活率下降更多,支持使用独立负面的先发制人,而不是简单地扭转BrainACTIV中使用的最大方向。 在激活增加方面,我们方法的优势在研究较少或混合选择的区域,如TE2p、IP0和IP1中最为明显,而在OFA、FFA、EBA和OPA等强烈的类别选择区域,性能比较可比较。 如FID分数较低(Heusel等,2017年)所示,我们的方法还不断产生更现实的视觉表现. 这些结果表明,与BrainACTIV中的线性内插法(消极方向只是正向的倒向)相比,我们方法的主要优势是构建一个结构化的空间,使分流取样更加容易,减轻线性内插法中的分流问题,这可以产生一致正确的活化变化,并产生更现实的图像,因为从这种潜在空间取出样本将避免从原始图像表达中过渡。 在目标表述方式吵闹或混合选择时,这一点尤其有用。

With our model trained on unit activations, editing the latent code toward the positive prior can generate representations that better activate the selected ANN units than the BrainACTIV ( Garcia Cerdas et al., 2025 ) in these examples.

blocks.en: 4.3.3. Optimize Unit Activations while Preserving Unrelated Features
blocks.zh: 4.3.3. 在保留无关特征的同时优化单位激活

blocks.en:
To demonstrate the strength of our structured VAE latent space, we trained our model with ImageNet dataset.
Standard VAE with a standard Gaussian prior. Then we constrain latent of VAE with multiple units activations, and only optimize the latent dimensions controlled by a certain unit. Compared to vanilla VAEs, our method achieves more significant changes in unit responses while preserving unrelated essential image characteristics. Besides modifying latent to prior values, which can manipulate activations and preserve features effectively, we further optimize the VAE’s latent variables z z using gradient-based methods, applying the Adam optimizer to adjust z z such that the activation r r of targeted network units is either maximized or minimized. The optimization objective combines the desired activation change with a KL divergence (KLD) regularization term, ensuring that the latent representation remains aligned with the prior distribution. The results of latent modification and optimization on both VAEs are shown in Figure 5 .

blocks.en: 5. Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 讨论和限制

blocks.en: We developed Vis-Lens, a framework that imposes an activation-regularized prior on a VAE to yield a structured latent landscape and then performs direct latent editing to steer activations in biological and artificial targets. This structured landscape can also modulate the activation of target units while preserving unrelated features. Vis-Lens shows clear advantages in changing activations in correct direction, keeping image realism and decreasing activations under our evaluation protocol. Inhibit activation is meaningful in clinical applications, reducing abnormally elevated activity in specific circuits has been associated with therapeutic benefit. For example, prior work has shown that attenuation of amygdala hyper-reactivity is linked to improvement in anxiety and trauma-related symptoms ( Ironside et al., 2019 ) , while reduction of subgenual cingulate hyperactivity has been associated with antidepressant treatment effects ( Hadas et al., 2019 ) . Thus, although our study is entirely in-silico and does not constitute a medical intervention, the ability to selectively suppress target-unit responses may be relevant for modeling clinically meaningful forms of neural modulation.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了Vis-Lens系统,这个框架在VAE之前强制进行激活 -- -- 规范化,以产生一种结构化的潜在景观,然后进行直接的潜在编辑,以引导生物和人为目标的激活。 这种结构化的地貌还可以调节目标单位的活化,同时保留不相干的特点. Vis-Lens显示,在我们的评估协议下,在改变激活方向、保持图像现实主义和减少激活方面有明显的好处。 Inhibit活化在临床应用中是有意义的,减少特定回路中异常高活性已经与治疗效益有关. 例如,先前的研究表明,亚米格达拉超能反应的减弱与焦虑和创伤相关症状的改善有关(Ironside等,2019年),而亚基因心跳超能反应的减少则与抗抑郁治疗效应有关(Hadas等,2019年)。 因此,尽管我们的研究完全属于硅酸盐,不构成医学干预,但有选择地抑制靶单元反应的能力对于模拟临床有意义的神经调理形式可能具有相关性.

blocks.en: Our framework can also extend to artificial neural networks as a controlled setting for studying feature visualization. Compared with the linear method, Vis-Lens does not assume that activation increase and decrease follow a single linear direction in CLIP space. Instead, it learns activation-specific regions in a structured latent space, and enables more controllable sampling, which is especially useful when neural responses are noisy and mixed-selective.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架还可以延伸到人工神经网络,作为研究特征可视化的可控环境. 与线性方法相比,Vis-Lens不假设活化增减在CLIP空间中遵循单一线性方向. 相反,它在结构化的潜在空间中学习激活特定区域,并能够进行更具可控性的取样,这在神经反应吵闹和混合选择性时特别有用。

blocks.en: There are also limitations to our work. The image generator and the CLIP encoder are frozen, so biases inherited from their pre-training data may propagate into the generated preferred images.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作也有局限性。 图像生成器和 CLIP 编码器被冻结,因此从它们预培训数据中继承的偏差可能会被传播到生成的首选图像.

blocks.en: In the future, we may scale the framework to additional modalities such as EEG, MEG or larger-scale brain datasets, and move beyond in-silico evaluation by testing the generated preferred images in human experiments; such closed-loop validation would further confirm the effectiveness of our framework and broaden its potential use in brain-computer-interface applications.
blocks.zh: 今后,我们可能会将框架扩大为EEG,MEG或更大规模的脑数据集等其他模式,并且通过测试人类实验中产生的首选图像,超越硅内部评价;这种闭路验证将进一步证实我们框架的有效性并扩大其在脑-计算机接口应用中的潜在用途.

blocks.en: B.2.2. Implementation of Diffusion Pipeline
blocks.zh: B.2.2. 传播管道的实施

blocks.en: All images are first converted to a 1024-dimensional representation with the frozen CLIP-ViT-H/14 encoder released by LAION ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) . For every split of the Natural Scenes Dataset we iterate once over the raw-pixel loader, compute the embeddings and cache the resulting CLIP features. Subsequent experiments therefore operate purely in embedding space and never revisit the expensive vision backbone.
blocks.zh: 所有图像首先被转换为由LAION发布的被冷冻的CLIP-ViT-H/14编码器(Shuhmann等,2022年)所显示的1024维. 对于自然场景数据集的每一分块,我们都会在生像素加载器上进行一次的去除,计算嵌入并缓存由此产生的CLIP特性. 因此,随后的实验纯粹是嵌入空间,从不重温昂贵的视觉骨干。

blocks.en: Image synthesis uses the “img-to-img” variant of Stable Diffusion v1.5 from the Diffusers library ( Leocadio, 2025 ) . We swap the original PNDM scheduler for DDIM (better speed/quality trade-off) and disable the safety checker to avoid unintended filtering. Every network in the pipeline—U-Net, text encoder, VAE, and the IP-Adapter ( Ye et al., 2023 ) that injects the CLIP embedding into the cross-attention blocks—remains entirely frozen. We use an IP-Adapter checkpoint compatible with the ViT-H/14 image embeddings employed for feature extraction.
blocks.zh: 图像合成使用来自Diffuses库(Leocadio,2025年)的"稳定分泌v1.5"的"img-to-img"变体. 我们将原来的PNDM调度器换为DDIM(更好的速度/质量取舍)并禁用安全检查器来避免出乎意料地过滤. 管道中的每一个网络——U-Net、文本编码器、VAE和IP-Adapter(Ye等人,2023年)将CLIP嵌入到交叉注意力块中——其余部分完全被冻结。 我们使用一个IP-Adapter检查站,与用于特性提取的Vit-H/14图像嵌入兼容。

blocks.en: During inference each RGB frame ( 512 × 512 512\times 512 px) is supplied together with a target CLIP embedding—either the baseline embedding obtained by ridge regression or the one produced by our activation-aware VAE. Unless noted otherwise we set the SDEdit strength to γ = 1.0 \gamma=1.0 ; We run 50 DDIM steps per image, draw a single sample, and fix the random seed to 42 for strict comparability across all methods.
